## FWI

```{r}
#| label: setup-fwi
#| include: false
if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("tasks/fwi/charts/index.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) {
  source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: data-loading-fwi
#| include: false
fwi <- tryCatch({
  read_csv(file.path(tabular_dir, paste0(city_string, "_fwi_weekly_95.csv")), col_types = "dd")
}, error = function(e) { message("FWI not available: ", e$message); NULL })

month_starts <- cumsum(c("Jan" = 31, "Feb" = 28, "Mar"= 31, "Apr" = 30, "May" = 31, "Jun" = 30,
  "Jul" = 31, "Aug" = 31, "Sep"= 30, "Oct" = 31, "Nov" = 30, "Dec" = 31)/7) - 31/7
```

```{r}
#| label: FWI-plot
#| results: asis

if (is.null(fwi) || nrow(fwi) == 0) print_text(paste_bold('No FWI data available')) else {

  # FWI risk category thresholds
  risk_categories <- data.frame(
    name = c("Very Low", "Low", "Moderate", "High", "Very High", "Extreme"),
    ymin = c(0, 5.2, 11.2, 21.3, 38.0, 50),
    ymax = c(5.2, 11.2, 21.3, 38.0, 50, Inf),
    color = c("#4CAF50", "#8BC34A", "#FFC107", "#FF9800", "#F44336", "#8B0000")
  )
  y_max <- max(fwi$pctile_95, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
  risk_categories$ymax <- pmin(risk_categories$ymax, y_max)
  risk_categories <- risk_categories[risk_categories$ymin < y_max, ]
  risk_categories$y_label <- (risk_categories$ymin + risk_categories$ymax) / 2
  label_categories <- risk_categories[risk_categories$ymax - risk_categories$ymin > y_max * 0.06, ]

  fwi_plot <- ggplot(fwi, aes(x = week - 1, y = pctile_95)) +
    geom_rect(
      data = risk_categories,
      aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = color),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    geom_text(
      data = label_categories,
      aes(x = max(fwi$week) - 2, y = y_label, label = name),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 2.5,
      color = ifelse(label_categories$color == "#FFC107", "#B8860B", label_categories$color)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = month_starts + 31/7/2, labels = names(month_starts), minor_breaks = month_starts,
                      expand = c(0,0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_max), expand = expansion(c(0, 0))) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("FWI in", city, "2016-2021"),
        y = "95th percentile FWI") +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = .125, color = "dark gray"),
          axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0)
  print(fwi_plot)
  cat("\n\n")
  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "nasa-fwi.png"), plot = fwi_plot, device = "png",
        width = 4, height = 3.5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
}
```
